arxiv-1804-03039.title: An Infinite Family of Maximally Superintegrable Systems in a Magnetic Field with Higher Order Integrals
arxiv-1804-03039.creator: Antonella MARCHESIELLO † and Libor ŠNOBL ‡
arxiv-1804-03039.description: Abstract We construct an additional independent integral of motion for a class of three dimensional minimally superintegrable systems with constant magnetic field. This class was introduced in [ J. Phys. A: Math. Theor. 50 (2017), 245202, 24 pages] and it is known to possess periodic closed orbits. In the present paper we demonstrate that it is maximally superintegrable.

arxiv-2103-12409.title: Binary disease prediction using tail quantiles of the distribution of continuous biomarkers
arxiv-2103-12409.creator: Michiel H.J. Paus, Edwin R. van den Heuvel, Marc J.M. Meddens
arxiv-2103-12409.description: Abstract In the analysis of binary disease classification, single biomarkers might not have significant discriminating power and multiple biomarkers from a large set of biomarkers should be selected. Many different approaches exist, but they merely work well for mean differences in biomarkers between cases and controls.

arxiv-2106-11319.title: Spectral function of fermions in a highly occupied non-Abelian plasma
arxiv-2106-11319.creator: K. Boguslavski, T. Lappi, M. Mace, S. Schlichting
arxiv-2106-11319.description: Abstract We develop a method to obtain fermion spectral functions non-perturbatively in a non-Abelian gauge theory with high occupation numbers of gauge fields. After recovering the free field case, we extract the spectral function of fermions in a highly occupied non-Abelian plasma close to its non-thermal fixed point, i.e., in a self-similar regime of the non-equilibrium dynamics.

arxiv-2208-04248.title: Fast 3D Sparse Topological Skeleton Graph Generation for Mobile Robot Global Planning
arxiv-2208-04248.creator: Xinyi Chen, Boyu Zhou, Jiarong Lin, Yichen Zhang, Fu Zhang, Shaojie Shen
arxiv-2208-04248.description: Abstract In recent years, mobile robots are becoming ambitious and deployed in large-scale scenarios. Serving as a high-level understanding of environments, a sparse skeleton graph is beneficial for more efficient global planning. Currently, existing solutions for skeleton graph generation suffer from several major limitations, including poor adaptiveness to different map representations, dependency on robot inspection trajectories and high computational overhead.

arxiv-2209-02690.title: Classification Protocols with Minimal Disclosure
arxiv-2209-02690.creator: Jinshuo Dong, Jason Hartline, Aravindan Vijayaraghavan
arxiv-2209-02690.description: Abstract We consider multi-party protocols for classification that are motivated by applications such as e-discovery in court proceedings. We identify a protocol that guarantees that the requesting party receives all responsive documents and the sending party discloses the minimal amount of non-responsive documents necessary to prove that all responsive documents have been received.

arxiv-2312-00675.creator: Dimitri Kanakaris Decavel
arxiv-2312-00675.description: Abstract Disclaimer This version of my thesis has been reviewed for typos and errors for the purpose of uploading it on arXiv. However, the content itself hasn’t been meaningfully altered. If you’d happen to find another typo or error feel free to contact me.

arxiv-2407-08029.title: A Critical Review of Causal Reasoning Benchmarks for Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-08029.creator: Linying Yang, Vik Shirvaikar, Oscar Clivio, Fabian Falck
arxiv-2407-08029.description: Abstract Numerous benchmarks aim to evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) for causal inference and reasoning. However, many of them can likely be solved through the retrieval of domain knowledge, questioning whether they achieve their purpose. In this review, we present a comprehensive overview of LLM benchmarks for causality.

arxiv-2502-08735.title: CV4Quantum: Reducing the Sampling Overhead in Probabilistic Error Cancellation Using Control Variates
arxiv-2502-08735.creator: Prasanth Shyamsundar, Wern Yeen Yeong
arxiv-2502-08735.description: Abstract . Quasiprobabilistic decompositions (QPDs) play a key role in maximizing the utility of near-term quantum hardware. For example, Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC) (an error mitigation technique) and circuit cutting (which enables large quantum computations to be performed on quantum hardware with a limited number of qubits) both involve QPDs.

arxiv-2506-17304.title: AlgoSelect: Universal Algorithm Selection with Information-Theoretic Optimality via the Comb Operator Framework
arxiv-2506-17304.creator: Jasper Yao
arxiv-2506-17304.description: Abstract We introduce AlgoSelect, a principled framework for learning optimal algorithm selection from data, centered around the novel Comb Operator. Given a set of algorithms and a feature representation of problems, AlgoSelect learns to interpolate between diverse computational approaches. For pairs of algorithms, a simple sigmoid-gated selector, an instance of the Comb Operator, facilitates this interpolation.

arxiv-2512-12461.title: Cross-Modal Representational Knowledge Distillation for Enhanced Spike-Informed LFP Modeling
arxiv-2512-12461.creator: Eray Erturk, Saba Hashemi, Maryam M. Shanechi
arxiv-2512-12461.description: Abstract Local field potentials (LFPs) can be routinely recorded alongside spiking activity in intracortical neural experiments, measure a larger complementary spatiotemporal scale of brain activity for scientific inquiry, and can offer practical advantages over spikes, including greater long-term stability, robustness to electrode degradation, and lower power requirements.

pmc-10544388.title: Automated detection of cardiac rest period for trigger delay calculation for image-based navigator coronary magnetic resonance angiography
pmc-10544388.creator: Gregory Wood, Alexandra Uglebjerg Pedersen, Karl P Kunze, Radhouene Neji, Reza Hajhosseiny, Jens Wetzl, Seung Su Yoon, Michaela Schmidt, Bjarne Linde Nørgaard, Claudia Prieto, René M Botnar, Won Yong Kim
pmc-10544388.description: BackgroundCoronary magnetic resonance angiography (coronary MRA) is increasingly being considered as a clinically viable method to investigate coronary artery disease (CAD). Accurate determination of the trigger delay to place the acquisition window within the quiescent part of the cardiac cycle is critical for coronary MRA in order to reduce cardiac motion.

pmc-10731298.title: A variable mineralization time and solution concentration intervene in the microstructure of biomimetic mineralized collagen and potential osteogenic microenvironment
pmc-10731298.creator: Xiujie Zhu, Haotian Bai, He Liu, Zhonghan Wang, Yao Wang, Jiaxin Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Hui Wang, Jincheng Wang
pmc-10731298.description: The absence of a conducive bone formation microenvironment between fractured ends poses a significant challenge in repairing large bone defects. A promising solution is to construct a bone formation microenvironment that mimics natural bone tissue. Biomimetic mineralized collagen possesses a chemical composition and microstructure highly similar to the natural bone matrix, making it an ideal biomimetic bone substitute material.

pmc-10748319.title: Xylazine Poisoning in Clinical and Forensic Practice: Analysis Method, Characteristics, Mechanism and Future Challenges
pmc-10748319.creator: Tingting Mai, Youyou Zhang, Shuquan Zhao, Youssef Sari
pmc-10748319.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Xylazine abuse is emerging globally, while the identification of xylazine lethal cases poses a great challenge in clinical and forensic practice. The non-specific symptoms delay the diagnosis and treatment of xylazine poisoning, the pathological changes and lethal concentration of xylazine in body fluid and organs of fatal xylazine poisoning cases are seldom reported and the other toxins detected in such cases complicate the role of xylazine in the cause of death.

pmc-11453030.title: Is lack of goal-conflict-specific rhythmicity a biomarker for treatment resistance in generalised anxiety but not social anxiety or major depression?
pmc-11453030.creator: Shabah M Shadli, Carina J Donegan, Muhammad SS Bin Mohd Fahmi, Bruce R Russell, Paul Glue, Neil McNaughton
pmc-11453030.description: Background:Anxiety and depression cause major detriment to the patient, family, and society – particularly in treatment-resistant (TR) cases, which are highly prevalent. TR prevalence may be due to current diagnoses being based not on biological measures but on symptom lists that suffer from clinical subjectivity, variation in symptom presentation, and comorbidity.

pmc-13434112.title: Athletes’ performance and injury management in sports training using association rules and data mining techniques
pmc-13434112.creator: Lvbo Chen, Bin Mo, XiaoYan Yu
pmc-13434112.description: Optimizing athletic performance while minimizing injury risk remains a central challenge in sports science. Although large volumes of athlete monitoring data are now available, existing studies primarily rely on modeling or isolated statistical analyses, with limited exploration of interpretable pattern discovery for understanding multi-factor relationships.

pmc-13693470.title: Structural Racism and Chronic Kidney Disease Among African Americans: A Research Process Guided by Public Health Critical Race Praxis

pmc-13693470.description: Structural racism has a profound impact on the ability of Black patients to access needed chronic kidney disease (CKD) treatment and care.
